exercises.prompt: Tell us about the last time you went to the beach or took a vacation.
Some people prefer active vacations, such as hiking or playing sports. Others prefer relaxing vacations, such as going to the beach. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about quitting their job to travel around the world for one year. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your city is considering allowing hotels to be built in a protected beach area to attract tourists. I am a member of the city planning committee. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
